recordedCaveats: Nine pre-protocol seed sources were previously desk-checked; none are relabelled as identified/included by an executed reproducible search.
Do not transform null fields to numeric zero. Counts and source inclusion are unknown until the corresponding run and screening are completed.
Past exploratory web searches do not constitute documented PubMed, Embase or full publisher search execution.
Full-version verification of some GOSH, HSSIB and NHS AVT passages is still pending, as described in the separate verification gaps log.
Access to Ovid Embase has not been demonstrated; if unavailable, document its absence and do not impute results.
Bounded exploratory web search captures 19 candidate records selectively; this is not equivalent to executing the PubMed field-tagged strategy or comprehensive licensed Embase search.
Provisional dispositions are based on openly accessible original pages or clearly labelled indexed abstracts; full-text and independent second-person eligibility checks remain required.
HSSIB AVT investigation is ongoing, with report expected in summer 2027 as stated on current HSSIB page; this is not completed investigation evidence.
Nine seed sources were provisionally re-screened by the project review process against written criteria, retaining pre-protocol provenance and pending independent reviewer.

Two Arca ranked PubMed-index retrievals returned 20 records each, with no full database total, independent PubMed query details or stable export; they cannot substitute for exact [tiab] fielded PubMed searches.
Original publisher full-text appraisals performed selectively and recorded in foundation-priority-critical-appraisal-v1.0.md, not a complete risk-of-bias systematic assessment.

Search coverage v1.1 formalises MEDLINE via PubMed as one principal biomedical database family, with additional PubMed records; Ovid MEDLINE would be an alternate interface rather than a distinct source to double count.
Cochrane CDSR/CENTRAL, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and Scopus/Web of Science were added to planned coverage only. No result counts or exports were generated from them.

v1.1 PubMed MeSH/free-text and Cochrane, Ovid Embase, engineering and citation-index query strings are candidate strategies and require platform validation and known-study recall checks before formal use.

On 19 Nov 2026 NCBI, PubMed and Europe PMC direct endpoints were blocked by available outbound network routes. A runnable NCBI ESearch export utility and frozen two primary S3A queries have been added but not executed. Formal search result counts remain unknown.

NCBI MeSH headings were checked via publicly indexed official NLM MeSH pages, but the configured combined query has not received a PubMed QueryTranslation response; controlled-vocabulary mapping still requires live validation.

Direct Cochrane, IEEE Xplore and ACM search-page access checks also failed (403/418/inaccessible respectively). No exact strategy was submitted to these database search interfaces, and no counts were returned.

19 Nov 2026 success: direct NCBI PubMed ESearch performed through GitHub Actions, main 29,110, ambient 366, overlap 323, union 29,153 unique PMIDs. Both query translations recorded, no NCBI syntax warnings. Main UID set retrieved through 8 disjoint EDAT windows with count consistency check.

Search result count is NOT full study eligibility: 29,110 broad records are highly nonspecific, no title/abstract screening or inclusion has occurred, and remaining Embase/Cochrane/engineering databases remain unexecuted.
